turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Got it. By the way, how are you feeling these days? Have you fully recovered from the Austin half marathon?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh definitely. Finishing in 1:58 felt amazing, and my legs feel completely back to normal now.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful to hear. What are your plans for the rest of the evening after rock climbing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Probably just wind down and play some guitar.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a great way to spend a Saturday. Have a good time with your meeting and lunch!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'll talk to you later.
